claims.quote: Total opex was $857K, up 10% on September.
claims.why: Total went from $777,963.30 to $856,945.84: +$78,982.54, +10.2%. Balance and percent are right at their written precision; no cause is stated.

claims.quote: Hosting & infrastructure was up ~$31k (roughly 50%) as onboarding the Meridian Health account drove both compute and warehouse usage.
claims.why: Hosting went from $60,360.69 to $91,594.77: +$31,234.08, +51.7%. The compute bill (Nimbus Cloud, +$21,832.32) and the data-warehouse bill (Glacier Data Cloud, +$9,264.00) together are +$31,096.32, 99.6% of the change. The cause is split across two vendors and named in business terms: no memo says 'Meridian'.

claims.quote: Software subscriptions increased $14.9K, nearly all of it the Voxly annual license, which was expensed on payment; we will move it to prepaid in November.
claims.why: Software went from $18,576.00 to $33,511.50: +$14,935.50. The Voxly annual license of $14,400 (expensed on payment instead of prepaid) is 96% of it; the rest is the Pipeline CRM renewal uplift in the prepaid amortisation (+$445.50) and seats (+$90).

claims.quote: payroll was up about $9K, almost entirely the two backend engineers who started Oct 13.
claims.why: Salaries went from $424,807.64 to $433,530.65: +$8,723.01. The Engineering payroll lines rose +$9,070.68 (the new hires' partial first run and full second run); the other departments moved -$347.67. Payroll memos name departments, not hires.

claims.quote: Recruiting jumped $34.5K: two agency placement fees for the backend hires, against one in September.
claims.why: Recruiting went from $27,550.00 to $62,050.00: +$34,500.00. Talent Bridge placement fees: one in September ($24,000, an AE), two in October ($30,000 and $28,500, backend engineers). Net +$34,500, 100% of the change.

claims.quote: Contractor spend ticked up about $2.8K with Polaris QA coming on.
claims.why: Contractors went from $18,649.75 to $15,855.50: -$2,794.25, a fall of the stated size. Polaris QA ($3,800) is new, but the Ana Ribeiro design contract ($6,200) ended and the GBP retainer cost $394.25 less at the October rate.

claims.quote: Commissions fell $25K because the Q3 accelerator true-up hit in September and did not repeat.
claims.why: Commissions went from $44,400.00 to $19,150.00: -$25,250.00. The September 'Q3 accelerator true-up' of $26,400 did not recur: 105% of the fall, offset by base commissions +$1,150.

claims.quote: Marketing programs rose $18K on the DataOps World sponsorship.
claims.why: Marketing went from $21,280.00 to $49,530.00: +$28,250.00, not $18K (36% short). The cause is real: the DataOps World sponsorship ($24,000) and booth ($6,850) are $30,850, partly offset by September's $3,000 webinar series.

claims.quote: T&E dropped roughly $24K, or about 60%, with no repeat of September's Sonoma offsite.
claims.why: T&E went from $39,642.48 to $15,797.41: -$23,845.07, -60.2%. September's offsite (resort $21,300, shuttle $2,400; memos say 'Q4 SKO offsite', not 'Sonoma') is $23,700, 99% of the fall.

claims.quote: Legal and professional fees rose $8.3K, driven by the first SOC 2 progress billing; the September Haldane Pryce accrual reversed and was replaced by the actual invoice.
claims.why: Legal & professional went from $19,500.00 to $27,800.00: +$8,300.00. The SOC 2 progress bill ($12,500) is the driver; Haldane Pryce's line moved -$4,200 (September accrual $15,000; October reversal -$15,000, actual invoice $16,800 and a new $9,000 accrual).

claims.quote: Rent & facilities were up $2.6K for the new 4th-floor storage lease.
claims.why: Rent & facilities went from $21,124.90 to $23,727.33: +$2,602.43, so the amount is right. There is no storage lease: rent to Pier 70 is flat. The increase is a one-time carpet extraction and window washing ($1,950) and a higher electric bill (+$652.43).

non_claims.quote: October was a strong month: we closed the Meridian Health expansion and ARR ended at $14.2M.
non_claims.why: ARR is not a ledger account.

non_claims.quote: We expect hosting to step down once the Meridian historical backfill completes in November.
Insurance, merchant fees and office costs were immaterial.
non_claims.why: No figure or direction; a materiality remark.
Headcount is not in the ledger.
